messages.subject: trouble installing Rattle on Vista
parts:
Hi,

I hope you can help.  The first time I installed I just typed,

> library(rattle)
> rattle()

in R.  I did not follow the special instructions for installing on MS Windows.  I am using Vista, 32 bit.  The Rattle data tab has no CSV option and I cannot locate the audit data set.  When I select <Execute> it asks if I want to load the weather data, but again, no reference to audit data.  I've tried uninstalling R and then following the special instructions for Windows, but the result is the same.  When I type,
> install.packages("rattle", dependencies=c("Depends", "Suggests"))
very little happens, presumably because I went through the installation process once before.  Is the solution to completely wipe out all R and Rattle related programs and start fresh?  I know how to uninstall R, but how do I uninstall Rattle and all related programs?  Is there an easier solution? 

The version of R I installed is 2.10.1
The version of Rattle is 2.5.21

Thanks for your answer.

The current version of Rattle uses the weather dataset by default. The CSV option has been replaced by Spreadsheet, and you can identify a .csv file.  Rattle does undergo regular development and so some of these things do change over time, and so some older papers will be slightly different.

To use the audit dataset, load the weather dataset first and then click in the Filename box and you will see the audit.csv file listed, which you should select and then Execute

> install.packages("rattle", dependencies=c("Depends", "Suggests"))
very little happens, presumably because I went through the installation process once before.  Is the solution to completely wipe out all R and Rattle related programs and start fresh?  I know how to uninstall R, but how do I uninstall Rattle and all related programs?  Is there an easier solution?

It sounds like it is installed properly. Just a little different to what you may be expecting.
